thread:
maddie: Heads-up — 30m until the release window. We need final confirmation on who can push to prod for the canary -> full rollout. deploy-bot shows 2 pending canaries.

samir: I don't have active prod MFA on my phone, is there a fallback?

julia: Can we pin the RC? I want to avoid the surprise hotfix floating into the release. RC tag is rlz-v2.3.7+hotfix.

deploy-bot: [system] Pending approval: 2 canaries. Policy: 'prod-deploy' requires MFA + role=deployer OR JIT approval from oncall_ops. Run `deployctl status rlz-v2.3.7+hotfix` to inspect.

oncall_ops: I can provision JIT for one hour if needed, but prefer MFA. Who needs it? @samir?

samir: Yep, samir here. I can do a quick MFA enroll but it'll take ~10m. If we need to go now, please JIT me.

maddie: Julia, can you confirm pin? If we pin rlz-v2.3.7+hotfix then the rollout will skip the latest commit in main. Good for stability.

julia: Confirm pin. Pinning now. Please note release notes include the DB migration toggle off by default.

maddie: Samir — request JIT. I'll need a confirmation message from oncall_ops and then deploy-bot can grant temporary deployer role.

oncall_ops: Granting JIT to samir for prod for 1h. To grant, I ran:```sh
authctl grant --user samir --role deployer --env prod --duration 1h --require-mfa true
```

oncall_ops: @maddie deploy-bot will pick up the grant in ~10s.

deploy-bot: [audit] Role grant detected: user=samir role=deployer env=prod duration=3600s by oncall_ops. MFA flag=true. Token id=tok_9f3b.

samir: Got it, activated MFA, can see deployer role. Running canary now: `deployctl release --canary rlz-v2.3.7+hotfix --timeout 10m`

julia: Watching logs. If latency > 200ms for 3m, abort and rollback to rlz-v2.3.6.

maddie: Agreed. Also note: if canary fails, do NOT reattempt auto-promote. Manual approval only.

samir: Canary started. First node reports: 200/200 tokens, no errors.

deploy-bot: [progress] Canary 1/2 completed. No errors. Metrics: p95=84ms, error_rate=0.02%.

julia: second canary green from my side. p95=90ms.

maddie: Okay green. Promote to full rollout. Remember we pinned — rollout will use rlz-v2.3.7+hotfix exclusively.

samir: Promoting: `deployctl promote --release rlz-v2.3.7+hotfix --strategy rolling --batch-size 20%`

deploy-bot: [progress] Rolling promotion started. Next check at +5m. Audit: deployer=samir initiator=maddie release=rlz-v2.3.7+hotfix

oncall_ops: Quick reminder — JIT ends in ~40m. If you need extended window, ping me with justification.

maddie: Noted. If any manual rollback, we'll follow postmortem template and include the pin decision timeline.

samir: Promotion finished. All healthy. Deployer token tok_9f3b will be revoked at expiry.

deploy-bot: [system] Full rollout complete. release=rlz-v2.3.7+hotfix status=successful. Audit link: https://ci.example.com/audit/tok_9f3b

julia: Thanks all. I'll update the release notes with the pinned RC and the canary metrics.

maddie: Good job. Follow-up: let’s add a small doc for 'last-minute MFA' on-call flow so engs know options (enroll vs JIT).

oncall_ops: +1 — I can draft and post to #eng-docs tomorrow.

samir: Thanks for the JIT, oncall_ops. :thumbsup:
